summary: Frontend-only testing of SEO + conversion-fix iteration for Bozzmail landing page. All 9 requested test areas pass: SEO head (single title, canonical, OG/Twitter, JSON-LD @graph with Organization/WebSite/SoftwareApplication/FAQPage with 6 matching Qs, noscript+h1), static files (robots.txt text/plain with Disallow /api/ + Sitemap bozzmail.com, sitemap.xml application/xml, llms.txt text/plain, og-image.png 1200x630 image/png), section order matches spec by offsetTop, hero copy and proof line correct, hero counter shows 'Be among the first to reserve', hero-proof to hero-switch gap <80px (0px), exactly 1 <h1>, hero CTA aria-disabled only (not disabled attr) and click-time validation produces exact toasts ('Pick the address you\'d like first.', 'This address is reserved by Bozzmail.', 'Please enter a valid contact email so we can send your invite.'), valid submit shows hero-reserve-success card, problem section (title/pain-0..2/bridge), FAQ 6 items with single-accordion behavior, pricing CTAs all read 'Reserve my address', download-section placed after pricing-section, header has text-link 'Why Bozzmail' with no border/background and single filled CTA 'Reserve address', all 8 nav links present including FAQ, Values section contains 'How it works' (not 'The Bozzmail promise'), mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390) and FAQ triggers tappable. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: On fast clicks before availability debounce resolves, submit toast says 'Still checking availability — one moment.' instead of the reserved/available message. Expected behavior per implementation; just note that user must pause ~1.5s after typing handle. Not a bug — handled gracefully.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 reservation via @example.com during valid-submit test
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 items verified against public preview URL. SEO served from frontend/public (index.html, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, og-image.png). JSON-LD FAQPage questions match the 6 on-page FAQs. Hero submit button uses aria-disabled (not disabled attr); use click(force=True) in Playwright. For availability-dependent toasts (reserved/available), wait ~2s after filling handle for debounce.
